channels.name: Ship landing page
channels.description: Design, build, and ship a high-converting landing page.
channels.spec:
Goal: Ship a focused landing page — hero, proof, features, FAQ, and a single CTA. Not a full app.

## Channel specific guidelines
- Claude Code implements the page, copy sections, analytics hooks, and deploy config.
- GitHub hosts the repository.
- Firecrawl scrapes a reference URL when the user provides one (messaging, branding, visuals). Rebuild a distinct page; do not copy verbatim.
- Keep scope to a marketing page. Auth, billing, and dashboards belong in Ship paid MVP.

starterPrompts.label: SaaS waitlist
starterPrompts.prompt: Ship a landing page for a new SaaS with a waitlist CTA. @claude-code can implement a fast marketing site (hero, proof, features, FAQ, email capture). @github can host the repository.

starterPrompts.label: From a URL
starterPrompts.prompt: I will paste a competitor or inspiration URL. @firecrawl can scrape messaging, branding, and visuals. @claude-code can rebuild a distinct landing page from that research. @github can host the repository.

starterPrompts.label: Product launch
starterPrompts.prompt: Ship a product-launch landing page with hero, social proof, feature grid, FAQ, and a strong CTA. @claude-code can implement it. @github can host the repository.

channels.name: Ship paid MVP
channels.description: Ship an MVP people can pay for: auth, database, payments, and email.
channels.spec:
Goal: Ship a paid MVP — something a user can sign up for, pay for, and get a confirmation email.

## Channel specific guidelines
- Claude Code implements the product.
- GitHub hosts the repository.
- Supabase provides auth, Postgres, and storage.
- Stripe handles checkout, customers, and subscriptions or one-time payments.
- Resend sends transactional email (welcome, receipts, magic links).
- Prefer a narrow first slice: one persona, one paid action, one success email. Do not boil the ocean.

starterPrompts.label: Subscription SaaS
starterPrompts.prompt: Ship a subscription SaaS MVP. @supabase can handle auth and Postgres. @stripe can take Checkout for the plan. @resend can send the welcome email. @claude-code can implement the app. @github can host the repository.

starterPrompts.label: One-time purchase
starterPrompts.prompt: Ship a one-time purchase MVP that unlocks access after payment. @stripe can charge once. @supabase can store accounts. @resend can send the receipt. @claude-code can implement the app. @github can host the repository.

starterPrompts.label: Usage-billed API
starterPrompts.prompt: Ship a usage-billed API MVP. @supabase can store users and usage. @stripe can meter billing. @resend can send receipts. @claude-code can implement the API and a thin dashboard. @github can host the repository.
